data.title: 佐天泪子 · 夏夜花火的浴衣回眸
data.description: 学园都市祭典的静谧高台露台，远方夜空绽放开璀璨绚烂的花火。佐天泪子身穿深蓝底金鱼花纹的日式浴衣，黑亮的长发别着清雅的白花发饰。她单手按着随晚风微敞的衣襟，在花火余烬映照的微光中转头微笑，双眸波光流转，透出少女特有的明媚与心动。
data.location: scenic hill terrace overlooking city festival fireworks display
data.action: standing on terrace in floral yukata against bursting fireworks, hair flower accessory, wind fluttering yukata sleeve, bright warm smile looking at viewer
data.lighting: vibrant multi-colored fireworks flashes illuminating night sky and balcony
data.mood: magical summer festival romance, bright unforgettable nostalgia
data.promptProse: Standing on a scenic overlook as colorful fireworks burst across the night sky, Ruiko Saten wears a navy floral yukata. Her black hair flutters with a white flower ornament as she looks back with a glowing, radiant smile.
data.animaCaption: Ruiko in a floral yukata looking back as festival fireworks illuminate the night sky.
